page.overview:
Who is Carmello Esposito?

Carmello Esposito is the leader of Carmello Esposito's Crew, a band of thugs that work for Marchesa Generosa Caramanici of the Border Princes.

He was tasked to kill Franz Lohner in the most painful way possible, as the former mercenary of the Grudgebringers had helped the marchesa's longtime rival lord Carl Svennson.
